# GastroSense AI (llms.txt)
> Cognitive Flavor Architecture & Molecular Pairing Intelligence OS

## Overview
GastroSense AI models culinary pairings based on shared volatile organic
compounds (VOCs) and 6-axis organoleptic receptor stimulation.

## Key Concepts
- **Foodpairing Hypothesis:** Ingredients sharing major volatile aroma
  compounds (pyrazines, terpenes, esters, lactones, aldehydes, phenols,
  sulfur compounds, amines) exhibit higher organoleptic affinity.
- **Harmonic Balance Index (HBI):** Measures equilibrium across 6 primary
  sensory dimensions (Sweet, Salty, Sour, Bitter, Umami, Kokumi).
- **Avant-Garde Techniques:** Reverse spherification, precision sous-vide,
  agar-agar fluid gels, cryogenic nitrogen shatter, lipid maltodextrin snow.
- **Allergen Safety:** Compliance with European Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011.
